title: coord.py list --by-operator shows each operator's live claims and approved budgets on a shared coord server
goal: coord.py list --by-operator prints, as JSON under operators, one row per operator of the store's live claims with the operator, the count of its claims and the sum of their approved budgets, the operator read from the served claim's holder; a key file whose name is no operator id, such as an email address, stays unserved

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, json, re
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
C = os.path.join(T, "clone")
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
shutil.copytree(".claude/hooks", os.path.join(C, ".claude", "hooks"))
for f in ("backlog.json", ".gitignore"):
    shutil.copy(f, C)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
shutil.copy("kb/_self/map.csv", os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "map.csv"))
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.makedirs(B)
EM = "jan.kowalski" + chr(64) + "corp-mail.test"  # built at run time: no address sits in the check's text
def stub(body):
    p = os.path.join(B, "claude"); open(p, "w").write("#!/bin/sh\n" + body + "\n"); os.chmod(p, 0o755)
stub("echo '{\"loggedIn\": true, \"authMethod\": \"claude.ai\", \"email\": \"%s\"}'" % EM)
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
ENV.update(PATH=os.pathsep.join([B, os.path.dirname(shutil.which("git")), "/usr/bin", "/bin"]), HOME=T,
           GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", KB_LIVE_DOCS="0", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"),
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=C, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def run(tool, *a, stdin=None, **kw):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(C, *tool.split("/")) if "/" in tool else os.path.join(C, "_tools", tool), *a],
                          cwd=C, env={**ENV, **kw}, input=stdin, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "base")
K = os.path.join(T, "keys"); os.makedirs(K)
def key(name, tok):
    p = os.path.join(K, name); open(p, "w").write(tok + "\n"); os.chmod(p, 0o600)
    kf = os.path.join(T, re.sub(r"\W", "_", name) + ".key"); open(kf, "w").write(tok + "\n"); os.chmod(kf, 0o600)
    return kf
KJ, KO, KE = key("jan", "tok-j-0123456789abcdef"), key("ola", "tok-o-0123456789abcdef"), key(EM, "tok-e-0123456789abcdef")
S = os.path.join(T, "served.sqlite")
P = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, os.path.join(C, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, "serve", "--bind", "127.0.0.1:0", "--keys", K],
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, env=ENV, cwd=C)
try:
    url = P.stdout.readline().strip().split()[-1]
    def c(kf, *a):
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(C, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--url", url, "--key-file", kf, *a],
                           cwd=C, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        return r.returncode, r.stdout
    code, out = c(KE, "list")
    assert code == 2, ("a key file named like an email address is served", code, out[-200:])
    for kf, k, b in ((KJ, "ST-aaaaaaaa", "5"), (KJ, "ST-bbbbbbbb", "2.5"), (KO, "ST-cccccccc", "1")):
        code, out = c(kf, "claim", k, "--ttl", "60", "--budget", b)
        assert code == 0, ("a served claim fails", k, code, out[-200:])
    code, out = c(KJ, "list", "--by-operator")
    assert code == 0, ("coord.py list --by-operator fails", code, out[-300:])
    rows = {r.get("operator"): r for r in json.loads(out).get("operators", [])}
    assert (rows.get("jan", {}).get("claims"), rows.get("jan", {}).get("budget")) == (2, 7.5), ("list --by-operator does not sum jan's claims and budgets", rows)
    assert (rows.get("ola", {}).get("claims"), rows.get("ola", {}).get("budget")) == (1, 1.0), ("list --by-operator does not sum ola's claims and budgets", rows)
finally:
    P.kill()
